pm_online_media.exp is an Oracle exp dump (EXPORT:V18) of the PM.ONLINE_MEDIA
table from the Oracle Database Sample Schemas,
https://github.com/oracle-samples/db-sample-schemas, which is distributed under
the MIT license below. docker/rdbms/oracle/setup/configure.sh loads it with imp
when PM.ONLINE_MEDIA exists and is empty. On 11.2, 12.2 and 18c the sample
schemas install the rows themselves, and 23.26 does not create the table. imp
from 11.2 and 12.2 cannot read a V18 dump.
